name: opportunities.candidates.matches.weekly-digest
description: Configurable match summary for entitled subscribers (paid|past_due|trial). Cron fires hourly so DIGEST_TIMEZONE twice_daily windows ([8,10) and [17,19) local) work for all zones; matching applies server-side filter by email_digest (off|twice_daily|daily|weekly), DIGEST_WEEKLY_WEEKDAY, and DIGEST_TIMEZONE. Matching is invoke-only (MatchInvoke on digest/user refresh). Sends top-3 unseen matches (notification receipts) above MATCHING_MIN_SCORE and emits candidates.matches.ready.v1. Free users use weekly-jobs-digest.
